text:
alex: Heads-up: planning a thin-slice kernel+quant swap tonight in the late window (01:00-03:00 UTC). Targeting 5% of traffic for first 30m, then 25%, then 100% if green. Need pin TTL and rollback criteria.

nina: +1. Which regions? canary in us-west, eu-west only for first slice.

sam: FYI devex warned about a small delta in logits from q8->q4 on chat-model-v2; will add eval set.

maya: Put a sticky pin for 4h after traffic ramp to avoid auto-unpin. We had churn last week. :thumbsup:

alex: Rollback triggers I'm proposing: 1) error-rate increase >1.5% absolute, 2) p99 latency up >20% vs baseline, 3) token-generation divergence leading to eval fail (devex alert), 4) OOMs or kernel crashes. Anyone object?

nina: Add a threshold for small mem leak: if worker mem growth >200MB over 10m.

sam: Agree. Also add immediate drain-and-pin on any 5xx surge from deploybot logs.

deploybot: ACTION: scheduled swap 'kernel-quant-v3.2' -> 'kernel-quant-v4-canary' at 2025-03-15T01:10:00Z for 5% traffic. Command: `/deploybot swap --nodepool runtime-canary --bundle kernel-quant-v4-canary --percent 5 --steps 5m:keep --pin-ttl 4h`

ops-oncall: I'll watch the first 10m. Paging if p99 >Xms.

maya: Release note snippet: "Optimized matmul kernel and q4 quant build: ~15% token cost reduction; expected small delta in sampling outputs. Rollout gated by regressions on chat-reference set."

sam: I'll push an eval job: `./eval/run.py --suite chat-reference --bundle kernel-quant-v4-canary --compare kernel-quant-v3.2` will run prior to 01:05.

nina: If we see noisy metric oscillations during ramp, prefer hold and increase sampling window rather than immediate rollback unless severe.

alex: Agreed. We'll do manual operators: if minor flaps, hold at 25% and extend slice 30m; if severe, full rollback and pin previous bundle across regions.

maya: One more: please annotate release notes with model-id and exact bundle hash. ops needs it for audit.

deploybot: UPDATE: swap executed at 1745679000. Traffic at 5% in us-west, eu-west. Monitoring hooks: `telemetry/engine/latency`, `telemetry/engine/errors`, `devex/evals/auto-alert`.

ops-oncall: Seeing a small p99 bump (~12%) in eu-west at 02:05 UTC, no errors.

sam: Eval job reports a ~3% reference delta, within acceptable tolerance. Pushing eval artifact: https://ci.example/runs/1234

nina: memory growth absent. No OOMs. I vote proceed to 25% at 02:40.

alex: Proceeding with deploybot step: `/deploybot ramp --percent 25 --regions us-west,eu-west --wait 10m`

deploybot: ACTION: ramp scheduled, will execute at 1745680200.

ops-oncall: I'll stay on watch for the 10m post-ramp.

maya: Reminder to update release-notes doc with rollout timestamps and bundle hash.

alex: If we need to rollback: command `/deploybot rollback --to kernel-quant-v3.2 --regions all --reason "<short reason>"` and then pin: `/deploybot pin --bundle kernel-quant-v3.2 --ttl 12h`.

sam: Captured. I can cut a hotfix build if we need immediate microswap.

nina: 👍 No other blockers.

alex: Thanks everyone. Will post post-mortem if anything nontrivial happens.
